issues.name: General complaints about Spotify's business tactics and app
issues.summary: Customers voice broad dissatisfaction with Spotify, calling its approach manipulative and the app poor, with some noting it uses too much data.

issues.name: Key features locked behind a paid premium subscription
issues.summary: Customers report having to pay premium to download songs or choose tracks individually, and say group sharing options are no longer available.

issues.name: Frequent ads interrupt listening for free users
issues.summary: Customers say free listening is interrupted by many ads, with ads playing after nearly every song and making the experience annoying.

issues.name: Playback gets stuck, plays wrong songs, or stutters
issues.summary: Customers report the app getting stuck in offline mode, playing a different song than the one selected, and stuttering on Android devices.

issues.name: App shows errors or will not open for login
issues.summary: Customers report that the app shows an error when logging in and that they cannot open the app or their account.

issues.name: Shuffle and play controls stopped working or moved
issues.summary: Customers say the shuffle button no longer works, the play button was moved, and they cannot figure out how to start their music after an update.

issues.name: App fails to open or loads very slowly after updates
issues.summary: Customers report the app stopped opening after a Samsung update and takes a long time to load even on a full network connection.

issues.name: Music switches to shuffle without user request
issues.summary: Customers say the app switches their music to shuffle mode on its own, playing many unrelated songs after the chosen track.

issues.name: Playlists appear empty or songs are missing
issues.summary: Customers report playlists showing as empty even though content exists on other platforms, missing new releases, and unliking one song removing another from the library.

issues.name: Redesigned interface removes features and is harder to use
issues.summary: Customers dislike full-screen pop-ups promoting songs, the removed search bar in liked songs, and losing the ability to play favorites in order after an update.

issues.name: Random song selection and inability to pick music
issues.summary: Customers say the app plays random songs, does not let them choose music themselves, and that the playlists are not satisfying.

issues.name: App reports offline status despite good internet connection
issues.summary: Customers say the app keeps showing they are offline or lack connection even with a strong internet connection, and that Spotify Connect no longer works.

issues.name: Lyrics not appearing for songs
issues.summary: Customers report lyrics are unavailable on their devices or do not show for any song, including after reinstalling the app.

issues.name: Premium subscription cost seen as too high
issues.summary: Customers say the subscription is very expensive, that micro transactions are requested often, and that the free listening limits make the price feel unfair.

issues.name: Offline downloads require internet or repeated login
issues.summary: Customers report downloaded music and podcasts cannot be played offline and that offline storage only works if they log in every week.

issues.name: Downloads keep scanning or re-downloading and fail to play
issues.summary: Customers say downloads keep scanning without finishing, playlists repeatedly re-download, and offline music still will not play.

issues.name: Premium payment or activation fails with cards
issues.summary: Customers report payments failing when adding a debit card, being unable to buy premium with their card, and their account switching to non-premium unexpectedly.

issues.name: Unable to cancel subscription and charged without use
issues.summary: Customers say they cannot cancel their subscription, were billed for a year without using the service, and that payments show as canceled.

issues.name: Search fails and reports no connection
issues.summary: Customers say searches show offline or no connection errors even with data on, and that they cannot find creators or podcasts.

issues.name: Music stops when the screen turns off or app is backgrounded
issues.summary: Customers report songs stop when the phone screen goes blank or the app is in the background, and playback does not pause or stop properly after disconnecting from a car.

issues.name: Downloaded songs disappear or stop playing after a month
issues.summary: Customers report large numbers of downloaded songs were deleted without reason and that downloaded music no longer plays after about a month.

issues.name: Audio is too quiet or poor over Bluetooth devices
issues.summary: Customers say audio plays softer than in other apps, even with high volume and quality settings, and sounds bad with Bluetooth on some phones.

issues.name: Logged out, crashing, or unable to access account
issues.summary: Customers report being logged out, unable to load or access their account, and losing money, with the app worsening over the past year.

issues.name: App install and update fail, and now-playing bar vanishes
issues.summary: Customers report the app will not update or reinstall, an annoying recurring issue after uninstalling, and the now-playing bar disappearing.

issues.name: Podcasts cannot be accessed or shown
issues.summary: Customers say they cannot access podcasts, their podcast is not showing, and the web link reports an unsupported browser.

issues.name: Playlist and group sharing does not work
issues.summary: Customers report they cannot share playlists, group sessions fail even with premium, and sharing to Snapchat produces a poor result.

issues.name: Sign-up and login not possible in the app
issues.summary: Customers say the app does not let them sign up or log in to a previously used account and that the registration process is discouraging.

issues.name: Customer service is hard to reach and unhelpful
issues.summary: Customers describe glitches, difficulty interacting with customer service, and a poor service experience that led some to leave premium.

issues.name: App keeps running in background and drains battery
issues.summary: Customers report the app keeps running after force stop and uses too much battery on their devices.

issues.name: Feature requests and mixed feedback on sharing
issues.summary: Customers mention wanting another feature, say two people cannot use the service together, and praise the music and podcast selection.

issues.name: No response from support on billing and feature issues
issues.summary: Customers say they cannot contact support about money taken from their card and received no answer to help requests sent months earlier.

issues.name: Support helped but required repeated reinstalls after update
issues.summary: Customers say support resolved their issue and the app works better, but reinstalling after updates was needed and the interface still needs improvement.
